lines.text: [squeaky, playful, fast little voice] क्लिक! क्लिक!
[cheerful, excited little child] अरे! वो क्या है?
[squeaky, playful, fast little voice] Shadow? Shadow?
[cheerful, excited little child] मुझे डर लग रहा है!
[happy children cheering together] Golu is scared!
[happy children cheering together] Golu is scared!
[happy children cheering together] डरना ठीक है, गोलू! हम साथ हैं!
[happy children cheering together] डरना ठीक है, गोलू! हम साथ हैं!
[happy children cheering together] It's okay to be scared!
[happy children cheering together] It's okay to be scared!
[cheerful, excited little child] टॉर्च! चलो, साथ में देखें!
[happy children cheering together] एक, दो, तीन… रोशनी!
[happy children cheering together] एक, दो, तीन… रोशनी!
[sweet, soft, giggly little girl] मैं बनी! मुझे भी डर लगा!
[cheerful, excited little child] अरे, ये तो बनी के कान!
[squeaky, playful, fast little voice] मेरी टोपी! मेरी टोपी!
[cheerful, excited little child] रात का लैंप — Night light!
[cheerful, excited little child] टेडी को गले लगाओ!
[cheerful, excited little child] मैं बहादुर हूँ!
[happy children cheering together] I am brave!
[happy children cheering together] I am brave!
[cheerful, excited little child] डर लगे? बताओ, रोशनी करो!
[happy children cheering together] Tell someone! Turn on a light!
[happy children cheering together] Tell someone! Turn on a light!
[cheerful, excited little child] शुभ रात्रि! कल फिर मिलेंगे!
[squeaky, playful, fast little voice] Good night! Good night!
